preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 65000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '123456789' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of digits from 1 to 9.

postconditions.expression: output == sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i, n) if int(s[i:j+1]) % 2 == 0)
postconditions.description: The output is the number of even substrings of s, where each distinct substring is counted separately.
